evidence: Labeled UTXO Db and Indexes, modifying src/txdb.cpp and src/txdb.h to synchronize coins database cursors and cache resizing.
rationale: The change prevents node crashes caused by AssumeUTXO cache rebalancing destroying active LevelDB iterators. As described, long-running RPCs like gettxoutsetinfo or scantxoutset keep iterators open after releasing cs_main, causing LevelDB to abort if ResizeCache() replaces m_db concurrently.
